title: Blackall Masonic Temple

terrainReference.basis: Approximate open grade on the west approach to the lodge entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named occupied Lodge on Hawthorn footprint and Queensland heritage entry 600032.
mapIdentity.scope: Four native corners of the standing roof envelope. Original hall, verandas and entrance subdivided using the 1908 view and heritage register 600032.

note: The heritage register records approximately 4.6 m at the lower wall and 1.8 m spacing between veranda posts. Overall building height and ground contact are approximate.
